<Component resource="page" name="one" id="style"/>
<EventContext value={false}>
 {open =>
  <>
   <AppBar>
    <Toolbar>
     <Link to="/">
      <IconButton color="inherit">
       <Icon/>
      </IconButton>
     </Link>
     <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}/>
     <EventControl bind="onClick" value={true}>
      <IconButton color="inherit">
       <Icon/>
      </IconButton>
     </EventControl>
    </Toolbar>
   </AppBar>
   <EventControl bind="onClose" value={false}>
    <Drawer open={open} sx={{'& .MuiDrawer-paper': {width: 240}}} anchor="right">
     <Toolbar>
      <EventControl bind="onClick" value={false}>
       <IconButton>
        <Icon/>
       </IconButton>
      </EventControl>
     </Toolbar>
     <Divider/>
     <Component resource="page" name="menu"/>
    </Drawer>
   </EventControl>
  </>
 }
</EventContext>
<Toolbar/>
<Container fixed component="main">
 <Outlet/>
</Container>
